Kelnacca finishes the training of his late student's Padawan.

Vader hurls Sidious down the Death Star II reactor shaft and dies of his wounds.

Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

Snoke, a strandcast proxy for Sidious, trains Kylo Ren until Ren cuts him in half.

Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi

Vader forges the imprisoned ex-Padawan into an Inquisitor; she later abandons the role to heal.

Ben trains with the Knights, then kills Ren and takes the name.
A hopeful prospect serving under Kylo Ren before the war's end.
Only part of the mentor's name survives, written into Boba Fett's chain code.
Jango raises his unaltered clone as son and trainee until Mace Windu kills him on Geonosis.

Beckett mentors Han through the Kessel job; Han shoots him on Savareen.
Gerrera rescues eight-year-old Jyn from Lah'mu and abandons her at sixteen.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

lines.title: The Rule of Two
lines.summary: Bane caps the Sith at a single master and a single apprentice, the student destined to overthrow the teacher. After Zannah, canon is silent until Tenebrous, whose pupil Plagueis trains both the Stranger and Sidious. Sidious then takes Maul, Dooku and finally Vader, who ends the line by killing him.
sources: Star Wars: The Secrets of the Sith: The Chronicles of Emperor Palpatine
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
lines.conflict: Canon names nobody between Zannah and Tenebrous, a gap of roughly a thousand years; the Stranger's tie to Plagueis rests on creator statements and Secrets of the Sith, not on screen.

lines.title: Yoda to Rey
lines.summary: One thread runs from Yoda through Dooku, Qui-Gon, Obi-Wan and Anakin to Ahsoka and, decades later, Sabine. Obi-Wan and Yoda also teach Luke, whose own students include Leia, Grogu and Ben; Luke and then Leia train Rey, who closes the saga.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back
Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

lines.title: Mace Windu to Ezra Bridger
lines.summary: Windu, begun by Cyslin Myr and finished by Yoda, trains Depa Billaba, who in the war's last year takes Caleb Dume. Surviving Order 66 as Kanan Jarrus, he passes the line to Ezra Bridger and gives Sabine Wren the swordwork to carry the Darksaber.
sources: Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 4
Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion

lines.title: Yaddle and Eno Cordova to Cal Kestis
lines.summary: Two survivor threads meet in Cal Kestis. Yaddle's student Jaro Tapal dies saving Cal on Order 66's day; Eno Cordova's student Cere Junda sees her Padawan Trilla remade as Vader's Second Sister, then takes Cal on in 14 BBY.

lines.title: Stellan Gios to the Stranger
lines.summary: Gios's prodigy Vernestra Rwoh trains Imri Cantaros in the Nihil years and, decades later, a Padawan she expels who becomes the Stranger. Schooled by Plagueis, he makes Mae his secret acolyte and ends up with her twin Osha, once Sol's student.
sources: The High Republic: A Test of Courage
lines.conflict: The Acolyte's finale ties Rwoh's former Padawan to the Stranger, but when he trained and when he was expelled are unrecorded.

lines.title: Lulad and Kelnacca to Ordea
lines.summary: The long-lived Wookiee Kelnacca finishes two generations of training. He knights Yarzion Vell after Lulad dies at Starlight Beacon, then, some eighty years on, completes the training of Vell's own Padawan, Ordea.
sources: Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide
lines.conflict: Vell's article dates Lulad's death to 232 BBY; Lulad's own article gives 230 BBY, the year Starlight Beacon fell.

lines.title: Dooku's dark acolytes
lines.summary: Denied a true apprentice under Bane's two-Sith rule, Dooku still gathers dark agents: Ventress, a Nightsister first taught by a Jedi; the saber-trained cyborg Grievous; Savage Opress, Talzin's plant; and Quinlan Vos, who falls and returns. Several switch masters as loyalties shift.

lines.title: Vader's Inquisitors
lines.summary: After Order 66, Vader drills fallen Jedi and captured survivors into Jedi hunters. Some were Padawans of other Jedi, such as Trilla Suduri of Cere Junda and Barriss Offee of Luminara Unduli. Reva, recruited by the Grand Inquisitor, turns on Vader; most of the rest are dead by 3 BBY.

lines.title: Ben Solo's teachers
lines.summary: Ben trains under his uncle from 15 ABY while Snoke, secretly built by Sidious's cult, works on him from afar. After the temple burns he joins Ren's Knights, kills their leader to inherit the name, and serves Snoke until he kills him too.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

lines.title: The Skywalker family
lines.summary: Shmi's son Anakin secretly weds Padmé; their twins are split at birth, Luke to Owen and Beru Lars, Leia to the Organas. Leia and Han's son Ben ends the bloodline in 35 ABY, and Rey, Leia's Palpatine-born student, takes the name as a chosen heir.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

lines.title: The Palpatine bloodline
lines.summary: Canon names no parents for Sheev Palpatine. The Sith Eternal grow Dathan in 12 BBY from Sidious's genetic template; he and Miramir hide their daughter Rey on Jakku before they are killed, and Rey destroys her grandfather on Exegol in 35 ABY.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

lines.title: The Ro family
lines.summary: Three generations hand down the Nihil's secret hyperspace Paths and the title of Eye. Shalla dies in 252 BBY, Asgar in 242 BBY, and Marchion turns an inherited role into command of every Tempest before the Jedi finally imprison him.
sources: The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 1
The High Republic: The Fallen Star
The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

lines.title: The Fett line
lines.summary: Jango, an orphaned foundling raised by a mentor known only as 'Jaste', becomes the template of the Republic's clone army. He keeps one unaltered clone, Boba, as his son; Omega is a second pure copy, and troopers like Rex carry his genome.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

lines.title: Houses Kryze and Wren, and Clan Mudhorn
lines.summary: Duke Adonai's daughters Satine and Bo-Katan lead House Kryze, one a pacifist duchess and the other a warrior. Clan Wren's Ursa and Alrich raise Sabine and Tristan and die in the Great Purge. Din Djarin founds Clan Mudhorn with Grogu, formally adopting him after Mandalore is freed.

offices.title: Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic
offices.summary: Head of the Republic and presiding officer of the Senate, elected to four-year terms that could be renewed once. Palpatine is the last holder; he converts the post into the throne of the Empire.

holders.note: Earliest chancellor canon names.
Leads the Republic as it rebuilds after the Sith wars.
Co-chancellor with Mollo; leaves office in 382 BBY to help her son.
Serves jointly with Greylark, then alone after 382 BBY.
Precedes Lina Soh; dates unknown.
Builds Starlight Beacon; in office through the Nihil war.
Holds the Senate tribunal on the Jedi killings.
In office when Dooku leaves the Order.
Announces she will not seek another term.
Re-elected in 36 BBY; ousted by a no-confidence vote.
Wartime powers let him outlast his term and declare the Empire.

sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
The High Republic: Light of the Jedi
offices.conflict: Articles order the last chancellors before Valorum inconsistently: Kaj is dated to 40 BBY and named as Valorum's predecessor in her own article, while Valorum's article gives that place to Skor Kalpana.

offices.title: Grand Master of the Jedi Order
offices.summary: The Order's most senior Master. In the High Republic several Jedi share the rank at once; in the Republic's last decades only Yoda holds it.

holders.note: Sole Grand Master by 32 BBY; exiled after Order 66.
One of several Grand Masters when the Legacy Run disaster strikes.
Captured by the Nihil and killed in 229 BBY.
Named after Veter's capture.

The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness
Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
offices.conflict: The Grand Master article ends Yoda's tenure in 19 BBY; his own article carries the title to his death in 4 ABY.

offices.title: Galactic Emperor
offices.summary: Absolute ruler of the Empire, created when Palpatine remakes the Republic in 19 BBY. After Endor, others govern in his name; Sidious claims the throne again from Exegol in 35 ABY.

holders.note: Proclaims the New Order with the Senate's cheers; killed at Endor.
Proxy ruler as Grand Vizier, trapped on Coruscant.
Governs from behind a figurehead under a counselor's title; dies at Jakku.
Returns from Exegol; destroyed by Rey.

Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
offices.conflict: Amedda and Rax are listed as holders only in effect: Amedda as the Grand Vizier acting for the dead Emperor, Rax under the title Counselor to the Empire.

offices.title: Chancellor of the New Republic
offices.summary: Mon Mothma drops 'Supreme' from the old title when the Rebel Alliance's chancellorship becomes the New Republic's highest office. The office ends with Hosnian Prime in 34 ABY.

holders.note: Carries over from leading the Rebel Alliance; still in office in 9 ABY, end unrecorded.
Killed when Starkiller Base destroys Hosnian Prime.

sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens

offices.title: Supreme Leader of the First Order
offices.summary: The First Order's absolute ruler. Snoke, secretly a creation of Sidious's cult, holds it until his apprentice kills him and takes the post.

holders.note: Outmaneuvers Sloane and Hux; title attested by 24 ABY.
Kills Snoke aboard the Supremacy; renounces the dark side in 35 ABY.

sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

offices.title: Mand'alor
offices.summary: Sole leader of all Mandalorians, a claim bound up with possession of the Darksaber. Holders include legendary ancient rulers, Death Watch's Pre Vizsla, Maul, and Bo-Katan Kryze, who takes the title twice.

holders.note: Legendary ruler who wars on the Jedi; undated.
The first Mandalorian Jedi; creator of the Darksaber.
Death Watch takes Mandalore from Satine.
Beheads Vizsla; Bo-Katan's faction refuses him.
Accepts the Darksaber from Sabine; loses it in the Great Purge.
Retakes the Darksaber and reunites the Mandalorians.

offices.conflict: Djarin's orthodox covert rejects Bo-Katan's first claim because the blade was handed to her, not won; Djarin himself held it in 9 ABY without taking the title.

offices.title: Ruler of Mandalore
offices.summary: Who actually governs the Mandalorian homeworld, under shifting titles: duke, duchess, Death Watch warlord, puppet prime minister, Jedi-appointed regent, Imperial viceroy and governor, and finally Mand'alor.

holders.note: Duke of Kalevala; killed in the civil war.
Her disputed inheritance fuels the war; deposed and later killed by Maul.
Death Watch coup backed by Maul's Shadow Collective.
Rules through a puppet prime minister.
Left in charge while Sidious holds Maul captive.
Named regent by the Jedi; forced out once the Empire rises.
Installed by Palpatine; killed on Krownest.
Takes his brother's post; killed when Sabine Wren's team sabotages his Star Destroyer.
Rules as Mand'alor until the Great Purge.
Returns after the Liberation of Mandalore.

offices.conflict: Who, if anyone, ruled Mandalore between Bo-Katan's removal as regent and Gar Saxon's appointment around 6 BBY is not recorded.

offices.title: Monarch of Naboo
offices.summary: Naboo elects its kings and queens, often very young, to set terms. The Empire strips the post to a figurehead; Kylo Ren later crowns himself king by conquest.

holders.note: Ancient king; undated.
Undated early queen.
Undated early king.

Wins a second term after Amidala.
Resents her figurehead role under the Empire.
As Supreme Leader, declares himself king of Naboo.

sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

offices.title: Eye of the Nihil
offices.summary: Keeper of the Nihil's Paths through hyperspace, passed from parent to child in the Ro family. Marchion Ro turns the post into command of the whole raider fleet.

holders.note: Dies in No-Space.

The High Republic: The Fallen Star
The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

offices.title: Grand Inquisitor
offices.summary: Head of the Empire's Jedi-hunting Inquisitors, answerable to Vader. Reva briefly holds the title in 9 BBY before the Pau'an original returns to reclaim it.

holders.note: Chosen by the Emperor to stand beside Vader.
Promoted by Vader, then defeated after she attacks him.
Recovers and takes back the insignia; dies hunting the Lothal rebels.

sources: Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion

offices.title: Daimyo of Tatooine
offices.summary: Self-given title of the crime lord who rules Tatooine through tribute from vassals and officials. It passes from Jabba to his majordomo and then to Boba Fett.

holders.note: Strangled by Leia aboard his sail barge above the Sarlacc.
Jabba's majordomo takes the palace.
Kills Fortuna and claims the throne.

sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land
Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa

offices.title: Master of the Knights of Ren ("Ren")
offices.summary: The Knights' leader holds the name Ren and its red lightsaber, both taken from the previous holder. Ben Solo kills the last human Ren to become Kylo Ren.

holders.note: Took the name and saber from his own predecessor.
Kills Ren; the title lapses when he returns to the light.

sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

offices.title: Leader of Crimson Dawn
offices.summary: Head of the most powerful crime syndicate of the Imperial era. Maul rules it from the shadows while Dryden Vos fronts it; Qi'ra rebuilds it after both are gone.

holders.note: Displaced when Maul and Vos take over the syndicate.
Secret ruler; dies on Tatooine.
Public face of the syndicate; killed by Qi'ra.
Maul's lieutenant, then sole leader until the syndicate dissolves.

offices.title: Head of State of the Confederacy of Independent Systems
offices.summary: Leader of the Separatist government through the Clone Wars. The post changes hands twice in its final year as Sidious disposes of his pawns.

holders.note: Founds the movement; killed over Coruscant.
Killed on Utapau by Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Slain on Mustafar by Vader.

sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith
